stories.head: AI security research scales; validation remains the gate
stories.fact: OpenAI reports a Linux research pipeline progressing from 2,308 candidate findings to 1,724 reproduced vulnerabilities and 948 privilege-escalation exploits, with candidate patches for review.
stories.why: Use staged evidence gates and human review in automated technical workflows.
stories.unc: Vendor-reported controlled research; generated patches are not all deployed fixes.
stories.alt: Four evidence stages distinguish candidate Linux findings, reproduced vulnerabilities, exploit validation and maintainer patch review.

stories.head: Wallet histories add predictive information in a new microstructure study
stories.fact: Ding and Zhai report that wallet-attributed features improve short-horizon Hyperliquid forecasts beyond an anonymous benchmark. Their chronological evaluation uses earlier wallet scores.
stories.why: Test feature availability, delayed inputs and matched placebos before trusting predictive gains.
stories.unc: Retrospectively selected specifications, consensus timestamps and data gaps limit deployment claims; executable profit is not demonstrated.
stories.alt: A chronological study timeline separates wallet scoring, model fitting and evaluation, with a retrospective-selection caveat.

stories.head: Nasdaq futures lag while broader contracts hold steadier
stories.fact: Reuters reports Dow futures +0.48%, S&P 500 futures +0.01% and Nasdaq-100 futures −0.63% at 5:04 a.m. EST, following Wednesday’s broad rally.
stories.why: Reassess SPY–QQQ relative risk and refresh executable quotes before placing orders.
stories.unc: Earlier press snapshot, not live prices, spreads or depth; no directional trade is implied.
stories.credit: Reuters via Yahoo Finance, November 5; 5:04 a.m. EST
stories.alt: Zero-centered bars show Dow futures +0.48%, S&P 500 futures +0.01% and Nasdaq-100 futures −0.63% at 4:04 a.m. CST November 5.

stories.head: Claims and productivity share today’s premarket release window
stories.fact: The New York Fed calendar lists initial claims and preliminary productivity/costs for 8:30 a.m. EST today, and the Employment Situation at that time tomorrow.
stories.why: Treat today’s labor/cost releases and Friday’s jobs report as separate information events.
stories.unc: Schedules are tentative; release values and surprises are unknown at cutoff.
stories.credit: New York Fed November calendar, checked November 5, 2026
stories.alt: Two dated calendar panels show November 5 claims and productivity at 7:30 a.m. CST and November 6 Employment Situation at 7:30 a.m. CST.

stories.head: Qualcomm’s annual earnings rise includes a large tax benefit
stories.fact: Qualcomm reports fiscal-2026 GAAP revenue of $43.120 billion, down 3%, and GAAP EPS of $12.70. Annual GAAP results include a $5.7 billion tax benefit; non-GAAP EPS was $10.54, down 12%.
stories.why: Separate operating results, accounting effects and forecasts when comparing earnings quality.
stories.unc: Non-GAAP measures require reconciliation; management’s diversification targets remain forward-looking.
stories.alt: Four financial labels separate Qualcomm annual revenue, GAAP EPS, the tax benefit and non-GAAP EPS; no additive EPS bridge is implied.
